subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the first CLI surface for pending exec approvals be read-only list/JSON only, or should it also include resolve/respond and watch behavior?
rationale: Listing pending command text and especially submitting approval decisions touches the exec approval visibility and authority boundary, so the permanent CLI contract needs maintainer intent before implementation or adoption of the broader PR.

options.title: Ship List/JSON First
options.body: Expose only read-only pending/list output through the existing visibility-filtered list RPC and leave resolve/respond and watch for separate security-scoped follow-ups.

options.title: Adopt Broader CLI Control
options.body: Let the active related PR own listing and resolving after it proves the authority path, live behavior, CI, and docs contract.

options.title: Defer CLI Exposure
options.body: Keep pending approval inspection in backend/UI paths until maintainers decide the operator recovery model is worth the added CLI security contract.

recommendation.title: Ship List/JSON First
recommendation.body: Expose only read-only pending/list output through the existing visibility-filtered list RPC and leave resolve/respond and watch for separate security-scoped follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest approvals CLI/docs history and already provided concrete scope guidance for this issue.
